items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I think they used Thurman Green, Ronnell Bright and me.

ctx.x: when it came to the recording, they only used about three of us out of the band. I think they used Thurman Green, Ronnell Bright and me. We were the only ones that they really used that had worked the sideline; we did the soundtrack also.
